title: Pinhole Projection with Radial-Tangential Distortion
hints: Order: normalize (X/Z, Y/Z), distort in normalized coordinates, then apply fx, fy, cx, cy.
radial = 1 + k1 r² + k2 r⁴; tangential dx = 2 p1 x y + p2 (r² + 2x²), dy = p1 (r² + 2y²) + 2 p2 x y.
Reject Z ≤ min_depth BEFORE dividing; otherwise points behind the camera project to mirrored, valid-looking pixels.
